219104.description:
Seo Won, the sole heir to the Kangsan Group and an S-class Esper. After being pushed to the brink of death by a certain accident, he undergoes a heart transplant from an S-class Esper in order to survive. However, that heart already bore the imprint of another Guide. To survive, he must find the owner of that imprint and bind them to his side. Meanwhile, Cha Han-Gyeom, an unregistered Guide who escaped after being used as a test subject at the Association’s unofficial research facility, has been living without even the will to live ever since losing his Marked One five years ago. Then, one day, a man engulfed in a dark aura on the verge of losing control appears before Han-Gyeom.

“Cha Han-Gyeom.”

A man who calls out a name Han-Gyeom has never heard before with such natural ease. And there, on that man’s heart, was clearly Han-Gyeom’s own mark. Seo Won, who needs Han-Gyeom to survive, and Han-Gyeom, who has already given up on life. The contract they entered into to save each other gradually transforms into obsession, possessiveness, and love...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

219139.description:
The 2024 Daimansai marks the 20th installment of the commemorative Kidan series, returning to its roots with Shouji Hashimoto, author of the first installment, "Yuurei Kanja."

This volume includes the title story "Danmatsuma" by Saburou Tsuyuki (Gorou Sugimoto) featuring a cover by Shigeru Mizuki. It's a story filled with screams from start to finish, featuring a mad criminal psychologist—taken from the collected volume, "Kiseijin." It's known within Togetsu Shobou as one of the hardest to find titles with the highest concentration of "Togetsu-ness."

Next in the collection is “Norowareta Shison,” a hidden work by Hashimoto which was originally published in the collection "Kaidan Ishikozume" (怪談石子詰, Togetsu Shobou) under his real name and the pseudonym Kiyoshi Tanigawa. Second is "Norowareta Shison," a timeless revenge drama.

Finally, three short to medium-length stories from Raigoro-chan—Shouji Hashimoto’s take on the legend of Momotaro, in which Goro-chan, the boy of thunder, punishes evil people. While not strictly a horror story, it is uniquely and extraordinarily unconventional.

(Source: Mandarake, translated)

219140.description: Yvette, the eldest daughter of the Cleaves marquis family, dreams of “bearing and raising the child of the person she loves.” But one day, she receives news that her fiancé has died in the war. Then, on the day of the funeral, the crown prince informs her that she is a “damaged” and “infertile” woman, and furthermore orders her to marry Grand Duke Owen Langford, a man feared as a “war maniac.” In order to protect the Cleaves family, Yvette agrees to marry Owen, only to discover that he has no fewer than three children. And since the children cannot accept their new stepmother, they do everything they can to drive Yvette out of the house... Will Yvette be able to overcome rejection and misunderstandings to build a true family with them? And moreover, what is the hidden truth behind this marriage of convenience...?

219141.description:
This volume collects two horror manga drawn for Togetsu Shobou by Goro Sugimoto (1924–1987, under the pen name Tsuyuki Saburou)—a legendary film collector with deep ties to Shigeru Mizuki.

1. Kiseijin (寄生人) [circa 1961, Togetsu Shobou]
“Shigeru Mizuhara is a young reporter for a third-rate weekly magazine. On his way to work, as he was daydreaming about how nice it would be to live a life of leisure if he were a twin, he was stopped by an old woman claiming to be a fortune-teller. When he peered into the crystal ball she held out, he saw a double image of himself, and the old woman told him that his wish would come true, albeit in a different form. That day, for some reason, his leg began to ache, and when he returned home early from work, a human face had appeared on his left knee. It was a “parasite”—a monster that had entered his body through his nose when he peered into the crystal ball, and was now growing by feeding on his blood. The parasite says it will be reborn as his twin, but what will become of Shigeru Mizuhara...?

2. Miira-jima (ミイラ島) [circa 1962, Togetsu Shobou]
Summer vacation was just around the corner. A notice recruiting elementary school students for part-time work was posted at a school in Arakawa Ward. It was a job organizing books at the Rockefeller Library, and a male teacher from the school was tasked with chaperoning as many as 150 students. However, the male teacher grew suspicious of the foreign interviewer’s attitude when he went to apply for the job, as well as the method used to split the students up and move them separately. The teacher and the children traveled by boat from Yokosuka to a small island in the Seto Inland Sea. There, the task assigned to the children was to read books one after another. Two weeks later, five children returned home each day, but according to a maid, five wooden crates were delivered to the island the very next day. In fact, the wooden boxes contained the mummified heads of children...

(Source: Kaiki Manga no Anagura, translated)

The main character, Suho, a former member of the special forces, becomes a firefighter and plays an active role at the fire scene. 219202.description:
A short story recap of the game Monochrome Mobius: Rights and Wrongs Forgotten:

In the small province of Ennakamuy, on the frontiers of the great empire of Yamato, there lived a young man with his mother and sister. One day, at the local lord's behest, the young man was investigating a small irregularity when he encountered a girl he’d never met.

The words the girl spoke were what shocked him: She told the man that his father was still alive.
Seeing a trace of his father in her and resolving to learn the truth, the young man and the girl set out together towards the land of Arva Shulan—a country that doesn’t appear on the map.

Faced with trials and perils, the boy chases his father.
He meets new friends and comrades who join him on his mission.
There will be struggles and victories and failures and partings.
The fickle vagaries of fate will place an epoch in the young man’s hands—

And one day, this man will be sung of in legends.

219215.description:
In the turbulent late Joseon period, face off against rampaging monsters!

The Joseon Dynasty, plunged into chaos by foreign invasions and power struggles, sees evil spirits, once sealed away by someone, awaken... and brutal murders occur everywhere! Jin Yong, a fallen yangban harboring a grudge against the nation, joins forces with a secret Japanese organization to drive Joseon to ruin. Mu-Yeong, a royal guard, risks his life to track down the monsters and rescue his lover, the shaman Hye-Ryeong, who has been kidnapped by them. Meanwhile, Chae-Yul, a troublesome inventor of modern weapons in the Special Forces, ends up following Mu-Yeong’s trail while investigating the unsolved murders caused by the monsters...

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)

title.native: 요괴난전

219216.description:
Itsuki, a boy who was killed by a random attacker and reincarnated. He reincarnates into a world where monsters called Magui exist in Japan – and he’s born into a family of Exorcists, who use magic to exterminate monsters!

Children of Exorcists are often targeted by Magui and if they’re weak, they’ll be killed again. So Itsuki made up his mind. To become strong – to never die again. He diligently practiced magic from infancy aiming for the strongest… only to realize.

“Oh no… I’ve worked too hard…”

A regular person who worked too hard but became the strongest!? A fantasy tale of overwhelming effort to defeat all the Magui with extraordinary power!
